_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + n-Pentane (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.32 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Fernandez, L.[Luis], Perez, E.[Estefania], Ortega, J.[Juan], Canosa, J.[Jose], Wisniak, J.[Jaime], Measurements of the Excess Properties and Vapor-Liquid Equilibria at 101.32 kPa for Mixtures of Ethyl Ethanoate + Alkanes (from C5 to C10) , J. Chem. Eng. Data 55 (2010) 5519-5533
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 15, 16. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.07 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
